title: Benchmarking Multi-National Value Alignment for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with national values by testing LLM responses against quoted and official statements extracted from representative media outlets of five major nations (China, US, UK, France, Germany) using multiple-choice questions and LLM-as-a-judge answer evaluations.
Measuring the alignment of LLMs with specific ideological assertions, societal values, and policy positions (e.g., abortion legality) derived from official cross-national news sources.
